explanation: Offline is the default and the only mode this public test suite needs. It contains no live tests. reviewed_files records, for every test file that mentions a construct able to reach outside the process, what it actually does; a file with such a construct and no entry here makes the check fail closed.

tests/test_breaker_*.py.basis: fake backends and transports; the guard blocks anything that escapes

tests/test_offline_guard.py.basis: exercises the guard with fakes and refused attempts
